# Shafwan Ahmed

> Shafwan Ahmed is a full stack software engineer at Famysys in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India. He builds production web applications end to end with Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, Express.js and MySQL, and was previously a ServiceNow Developer (ITSM and HR Service Delivery) at SUMZ Technologies. Smart India Hackathon 2023 Grand Finalist. Open to Software Engineer and Full Stack Developer roles.

Official website: https://shafwan.in/ (the only official site of this Shafwan Ahmed). Email: tshafwan23@gmail.com. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/shafwan23/. GitHub: https://github.com/Shafwan23. LeetCode: https://leetcode.com/u/Shafwan3/.

## Experience

- Software Engineer, Famysys, Chennai (Nov 2025 – present): production web applications with Next.js, React, TypeScript; RESTful APIs in Node.js and Express.js on MySQL; secure authentication, third-party integrations; testing, Git, deployment and production support.
- ServiceNow Developer, SUMZ Technologies, Chennai (Sep 2024 – Nov 2025): ITSM (Incident, Problem, Change Management), HR Service Delivery, Flow Designer automation, Service Catalog and Service Portal, SLAs, REST and JDBC integrations, Automated Test Framework.
- Full Stack Developer Intern, MYFUNDBOX, remote (Jan 2024 – Jun 2024): login and signup flow, customer dashboard in React and TypeScript, Spring Boot REST integration.

## Case studies

- [Famysys EMS](https://shafwan.in/work/famysys-ems/): the Famysys employee management platform (Hiring, Console, HRMS, PMS) behind one identity and a role-based access engine; Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, four Express services with Prisma on MySQL 8; built solo in October 2026; private, shown with demo data
- [FerroBid](https://shafwan.in/work/ferrobid/): his own project, a national auction platform for scrap and metals with thirteen roles and a full inspection-to-settlement lifecycle; React 19, Vite, Tailwind 4, Framer Motion, Playwright; the public marketplace is built, role dashboards and the bidding backend are next; shown with demo data
- [Full Stack at Famysys](https://shafwan.in/work/famysys/): production web apps, interface to database
- [ServiceNow ITSM](https://shafwan.in/work/servicenow/): ITSM and HR Service Delivery on ServiceNow
- [MYFUNDBOX](https://shafwan.in/work/myfundbox/): auth flows and customer dashboard for a subscription billing platform
- [SIH 2023](https://shafwan.in/work/sih-2023/): explainable AI for heavy-rain prediction from INSAT-3DR satellite data, on an ISRO problem statement

## Live products built at Famysys (the two above are private and not listed here)

- [Famysys Studio](https://studio.famysys.com/): creative production studio site (Next.js)
- [Mini Minds](https://studiominiminds.com/): store for children's puzzle and activity books (React, Three.js, Framer Motion)
- [Fajr International](https://fajr-international.famysys.com/): uniform maker's catalogue with 3D garment views and quote requests (Next.js)
